factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025, the Group’s gross profit decreased by EUR 10.3 million to EUR 143.2 million (EUR 153.6 million in the financial year 2024). EBITDA declined by EUR 45.1 million and amounted to EUR 130.1 million. The EBITDA margin (%) was 17.0% (2024: 22.3%)'

factual_claims.claim: EBIT decreased to EUR 50.3 million from EUR 77.4 million, while net profit fell 57.1% to EUR 17.3 million, or EUR 0.023 per share compared with EUR 0.054 in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s EBITDA was EUR 130.1 million (EUR 175.2 million in the financial year 2024) and the audited net profit for the period was EUR 17.3 million (EUR 40.3 million in the financial year 2024). Earnings/loss per share was EUR 0.02 (2024: EUR 0.05)'

factual_claims.claim: The net profit margin declined from 5.1% to 2.3%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Demand was affected by weak consumer and business confidence, economic challenges in the core markets, geopolitical tensions and intense competition.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The following operational factors impacted the Group’s revenue and operating results in 2025: Demand was impacted by low consumer and business confidence, ongoing economic challenges in the Group’s core markets, and heightened global geopolitical tensions'

factual_claims.claim: Passenger volumes decreased 0.9% to 5.5 million, cargo units declined 19.2% to 245,004, and passenger vehicles fell 2.2% to 760,473.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025 (1 January – 31 December), AS Tallink Grupp and its subsidiaries (the Group) carried 5.5 million passengers, which is down 0.9% compared to the financial year 2024. The number of cargo units transported decreased by 19.2% to 245,004 while the number of passenger vehicles was down by 2.2% to 760,473, year-on-year'

factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Finland passenger numbers increased 1.8% and revenue rose to EUR 314.5 million, but the segment result declined by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The number of passengers carried on the Estonia-Finland route increased by 1.8% year-on-year. Revenue from the Estonia-Finland route increased by EUR 1.7 million to EUR 314.5 million, while the segment result decreased by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million, year-on-year'

factual_claims.claim: Finland-Sweden revenue decreased to EUR 225.5 million and the segment result fell to EUR 1.3 million, partly reflecting 68 days of maintenance on two vessels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025, the number of passengers on the Finland-Sweden routes decreased by 2.4%. The routes’ revenue decreased by EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million and the segment result decreased by EUR 1.5 million to EUR 1.3 million, year-on-year. The routes’ results were impacted by maintenance works on the cruise ferries Silja Serenade and Baltic Princess that totalled 68 days in the first quarter of 2025'

factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Sweden revenue dropped EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million, although its loss narrowed to EUR 1.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Year-on-year, the revenue of the Estonia-Sweden routes decreased by EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million. The segment result improved by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million'

factual_claims.claim: Other-segment revenue declined to EUR 145.5 million, while its result remained broadly stable at EUR 28.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Revenue from the segment Other decreased by EUR 7.3 million compared to the financial year 2024 amounting to EUR 145.5 million. The segment result was EUR 28.5 million, remaining broadly in line with the previous financial year'

factual_claims.claim: Cost pressures included personnel expenses rising 4.3% to EUR 201.0 million and fuel and emission costs increasing to EUR 96.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s total personnel expenses amounted to EUR 201.0 million (EUR 192.8 million in the financial year 2024). Fuel and emission costs for the financial year 2025 amounted to EUR 96.5 million (EUR 95.8 million in the financial year 2024)'

factual_claims.claim: These effects were partly offset by an EUR 18.0 million reduction in depreciation and amortisation, including EUR 16.7 million from extending the estimated useful lives of most cruise and passenger vessels to 45 years, and by lower net finance costs, which fell to EUR 21.4 million from EUR 28.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Amortisation and depreciation expense decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million year-on-year. Depreciation expense decreased mainly due to the alignment of the estimated useful lives of the cruise and passenger vessels (except for shuttle vessels) to 45 years... As a result of a decreased outstanding loan balance and declining interest rates, net finance costs declined by EUR 6.8 million year-on-year to EUR 21.4 million in the financial year 2025 (EUR 28.3 million in the financial year 2024)'

factual_claims.claim: Net operating cash flow remained positive at EUR 127.1 million, although down from EUR 153.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s net operating cash flow for the financial year 2025 was positive at EUR 127.1 million (EUR 153.4 million in the financial year 2024)'

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash flow was positive at EUR 46.1 million, supported by EUR 78.8 million from the sale of three vessels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Net cash flow from investing activities was EUR 46.1 million (EUR 3.2 million in the financial year 2024), including proceeds from disposals of EUR 78.8 million. During the financial year, the Group sold three vessels'

factual_claims.claim: Capital expenditure increased to EUR 33.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Capital investments in 2025 totalled EUR 33.0 million, while planned maintenance and repair works of vessels totalled 73 days'

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities declined 19.9% to EUR 445.9 million and net debt fell to EUR 432.4 million, despite the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio increasing to 3.3.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million compared to EUR 537.7 million as at 31 December 2024. The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025 (3.1 as at 31 December 2024)'

factual_claims.claim: The Group paid EUR 44.6 million in dividends and will propose another EUR 0.06 per share for 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on 20 May 2025 adopted a resolution to pay a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2025 in the total amount of EUR 44.6 million... In agreement with the Supervisory Board of the Group, the Management Board of the Group will propose to the General Meeting of Shareholders that a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share be paid in 2026'

factual_claims.claim: It maintained a EUR 110.4 million liquidity buffer at year-end and continued to report sufficient liquidity for operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'At 31 December 2025, the Group’s cash and cash equivalents totalled EUR 13.5 million (EUR 18.7 million at 31 December 2024). In addition, available unused overdraft credit lines amounted to EUR 96.9 million (EUR 75.0 million in 2024). The total liquidity buffer (cash, cash equivalents and unused credit facilities) amounted to EUR 110.4 million at 31 December 2025 (EUR 93.7 million at 31 December 2024)... In management’s opinion, the Group has sufficient liquidity to support its operations'
